Mina K.: Heads-up: small canary showing zh->en BLEU drop after yesterday's preprocess tweak.
Cheng Li: Confirmed. Avg source tokens jumped ~40% on sample shard.
Mina K.: We turned on lang_detect to catch translit boundaries. It seems to split Han from adjacent latin/numbers a lot.
Samir P.: Can you paste one failing line?
Cheng Li: Raw: 2025年Q1 results: revenue $5M — see chart.
Cheng Li: With lang_detect=true tokens -> [2025, 年, Q, 1, results, :, revenue, $, 5, M, —, see, chart, .] (14)
Cheng Li: Baseline (lang_detect=false) -> [2025年, Q1, results, :, revenue, $5M, —, see, chart.] (9)
Luca V.: Language hints are forcing extra boundaries so sentencepiece produces more subwords. That increases decode steps and likely hurts BLEU.
Mina K.: Small eval: 2k pairs, BLEU 32.1 -> 28.3 after change.
eval-bot: Alert: regression detected on newsdev-zh-en (tokens/source +39%, BLEU -3.8).
Samir P.: Action: revert lang_detect on canary behind feature flag. I'll open a PR to default=false and add telemetry.
Cheng Li: I'll bisect the preprocess commits and upload a minimal repro to s3.
Mina K.: I'll run INT8 quant smoke to check sensitivity to longer token sequences.
Luca V.: I'll add token-per-source distribution to dashboards and update runbook about CJK+Latin hinting.
